task:
Create a clean replacement implementation for open PR #532, Enforce fail-closed pull request acceptance, because the attempted cloud Codex repair reported local commit a04c4ed on an ephemeral branch but did not push it and that commit does not exist in this repository. Start from current origin/main at fd64ef8e14b5b026cec2d14949115ab681fb0b7d. Read CLAUDE.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/development/repo-hygiene.md, docs/development/chatgpt-ops-control-plane.md, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, all tracked .github/workflows/*.yml and *.yaml, tests/test_ci_stall_detection.py, and tests/test_repo_hygiene_contract.py. Fetch and inspect origin/codex/run-33428821898-1 (PR #532 head 3d1d04c354575823ea5f9fe7c7a9e9868d5423c2) and use its diff as source material, but do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or modify that branch; the wrapper will commit and push your isolated branch. Reproduce the intended complete governance change on your isolated branch and correct every verified review finding below.

Scope and boundaries: repository-governance documentation, pull-request template, Dependabot auto-merge workflow removal, and focused structural tests only. Do not change product/runtime/data behavior, production, deployment, databases, roadmap authority, Stage 27 implementation, V3 runtime, CRE/CPE mechanics, or Journal work. Preserve main's unrelated behavior.

Required intended policy from PR #532:
1. Add one canonical pull-request acceptance policy under docs/development/. It must require all protected CI/security/coverage/status checks plus both Codex Review and Octopus Review against the exact latest PR head SHA.
2. Require paginated inspection of top-level PR conversation comments, formal review bodies, inline review comments, and unresolved review conversations/threads. Every substantive finding must have an explicit disposition, and no substantive unresolved thread may remain. Any new commit invalidates prior CI/review evidence.
3. Reviewer services that are pending or still reviewing must be triggered and awaited. An explicit owner waiver is allowed only when the named reviewer service has actually failed or is unavailable, and only with replacement manual-review evidence, recorded accepted risk, and the other policy safeguards. Do not allow a waiver for ordinary pending/in-progress review.
4. Update .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md with exact latest-head evidence fields and wording consistent with the policy.
5. Remove .github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml so CI alone cannot queue a dependency PR for merge. Preserve a fail-closed posture.
6. Add/update CLAUDE.md and any appropriate governance references so contributors must apply the acceptance policy. Avoid duplicate or contradictory authority.
7. Add focused tests in tests/test_pull_request_acceptance_policy.py and only other contract tests genuinely needed. Do not weaken unrelated coverage.

Verified Codex Review repairs that must be included:
A. Robust auto-merge detection: replace any exact-substring-only guard with PyYAML parsing of every tracked .github/workflows/*.yml and *.yaml, recursively inspect job-step run strings, and detect a real shell invocation of `gh pr merge` containing an `--auto` argument regardless of positional argument order, extra whitespace, shell line continuations, or quoting. Avoid false positives from comments, quoted prose, or unrelated commands using `--auto`. Add focused unit/fixture cases proving at least `gh pr merge --auto "$PR_URL"`, `gh pr merge "$PR_URL" --auto`, and a multiline invocation are rejected, while an unrelated `--auto` command, comment, and quoted prose are not. Use shell-aware parsing/tokenization with bounded, understandable behavior; do not merely search text.
B. Waiver restriction: template and policy must state pending/still-reviewing services are triggered and awaited; owner waiver applies only to actual service failure or unavailability and retains replacement manual-review/evidence requirements.
C. One-time transition: deleting the workflow does not clear existing server-side auto-merge. Add a concise canonical transition rule requiring an audit and cancellation of pre-existing server-side auto-merge requests before policy acceptance. Record historical evidence that the audit was completed on 2026-08-31: open Dependabot PRs #513 and #505 had auto_merge null; #492 and #502 had legacy github-actions[bot] requests and were closed fail-closed to cancel them, leaving no open Dependabot PR with auto-merge enabled. Keep the permanent machine contract focused on the transition rule rather than hard-coding the PR-number list except in historical prose.

Test environment: the current worker definition deliberately recreated an empty .venv before Codex. If pytest, Ruff, or PyYAML are unavailable, install only the existing pinned tests/requirements-ci.txt with `.venv/bin/python -m pip install --requirement tests/requirements-ci.txt`; do not install unpinned ad-hoc tools or invent another manifest. Use `.venv/bin/python -m pytest` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff` explicitly if plain python is not on PATH.

Validation: run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_pull_request_acceptance_policy.py tests/test_ci_stall_detection.py tests/test_repo_hygiene_contract.py tests/test_bounded_hygiene_pass.py`, any additional directly affected contract test, `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check` on changed Python tests, parse all workflow YAML files with pinned PyYAML, and `git diff --check`. Inspect the final diff against origin/main and confirm the Dependabot auto-merge workflow is deleted, no unrelated files changed, and the test guard covers both .yml and .yaml. End with exact changed files, exact tests/results, and limitations. Do not merge or deploy; the wrapper will commit and push the isolated replacement branch.
